title: run-trigger contract data
description: Reference schema (FAFF-496). The SHAPE of the run-START trigger verdict that `faff run-start` PRODUCES and `faff contract run-trigger` VALIDATES (consumer-side Pattern-B conformance — it re-derives {verdict, reason} from `signals` and rejects a non-conforming declared verdict, mirroring l4-topology-envelope / prdr-admission). run-start is the MIRROR of `faff run-done`: run-done is the terminating predicate (fails toward `escalate`), run-start the starting predicate (fails toward `refuse`). It composes faff's already-shipped run-start signals — target resolution, the ADR-0069 outward-only read (`signals.outward`, mechanism = FAFF-521), the `prd-readiness` admissibility verdict, and `faff prdr coverage`'s `.covered` — into the one decision that opens a `/faff-beep-boop` run: plan | drain | refuse. The ladder is a FIXED refusal-biased floor (spec §4, first-failing-check-wins): target -> outward -> PRD presence/ambiguity -> admissibility -> coverage. `verdict` is the fixed three-valued contract; `reason` carries the closed reason vocabulary bound 1:1 to the verdict; there is no policy layer (unlike run-termination) — the floor is entirely fixed, which is the whole point of the refusal bias. Fail-safe toward `refuse`: a malformed/all-false signal bundle derives `refuse / no-target`, so the privileged `plan` is unreachable unless every affirmative signal is explicitly true.
